body_markdown:
ATLANTA


, Sept. 10, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Invesco Ltd. (NYSE:IVZ )1, a leading global asset management firm announced today preliminary month-end assets under management (AUM) of $2,562.1 billion, an increase of 4.7% versus previous month-end. The firm delivered net long-term inflows of $27.6 billion in the month. Money market net inflows were $35.8 billion. AUM was positively impacted by favorable market returns which increased AUM by $49 billion. FX increased AUM by $2.7 billion. Preliminary average total AUM for the quarter through August 31 was $2,492.2 billion, and preliminary average active AUM for the quarter through August 31 was $1,236.6 billion.
